propositions: _apply_authorship returns silently when signing_key is configured but author_id is unresolvable and require_authenticated is off, hiding unsigned writes
fsck authorship tally is store-wide and uncounted, making per-env signed-rate problems invisible when other envs have healthy signing volume
AC2: fsck must report as a counted UNSIGNED_ENV issue any env_id with zero signed events or all Unknown-authored events, gated to active envs that wrote at or after store's first signed event
AC3: _apply_authorship must emit a logger.warning when signing is skipped due to missing identity or signing key, naming event uuid and which input was missing, without failing the write
Dormant pre-signing envs must not trigger unsigned-env findings to avoid false positives
New leaf module fsck_authorship.py feeds EnvAuthorshipTally from payloads Check 1 already parses, adding no extra I/O pass
